method: Complete named explanatory fields from the exact subject/pointer. Original summaries, subjects and historical reviews unchanged. This is an excerpt, not a standalone replacement contract or review.

summary.answer: Defaults false/nil mode to customizationMode; lazily fills Heroes.HeroList[mode] from engine and returns cached value. No invalidation here. Lazily creates outer mode table and fills missing hero entry from engine customization query; returns shared cached entry. Queries asset list, selects index+1, returns icon only when entry exists and type==tag; otherwise blacktransparent. Defines a same-body entitlement predicate. Rejects nondefault nonloot without entitlement unless fake-all; rejects unowned/unavailable/out-of-set loot unless blackmarket enabled; rejects required unowned entitlement; otherwise true. It authorizes a UI option in source, not service ownership. Reads current mode, requests saveloadout(controller,mode), then calls the exact hashed CoDShared provider with same args. No result/commit confirmation is checked.
